methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); cable signals

pit_profile.why: We are a leading broadband connectivity company and cable operator with services available to an estimated 57 million homes and businesses in 41 states through our Spectrum® brand. The 10-K's 'Our business is subject to seasonal and cyclical variations.' names seasonal service areas and advertising patterns ('Our revenue is subject to cyclical advertising patterns and changes in viewership levels.'), not the cycle of the business's earnings, so DURABLE (the SPGI reading). STREAMING ('cord-cutting / streaming displaces linear TV networks and pay-TV bundles') is live from 2015-08-04 and the FY2024 10-K's words put it on the watch list: company-acknowledged, with no dated evidence that the market prices it for Charter. Of the other live themes, OFFSHORE to 'lower-cost offshore delivery (Indian IT services) takes share and price from Western consulting, systems integration and outsourcing', CLOUD to 'public cloud displaces on-premise hardware, storage, legacy databases and data-center outsourcing', ECOMMERCE to 'e-commerce (Amazon effect) displaces physical retail, malls, grocery, distribution', ENERGY_TRANSITION to 'decarbonisation strands oil, gas and coal reserves and refining', EV to 'battery-electric vehicles displace ICE powertrains, auto parts suppliers and fuel retail', CRYPTO to 'crypto / DeFi disintermediates payments networks, banks, exchanges, remittance', GENAI to 'generative / autonomous AI substitutes the core product: software seats, IT services and BPO hours, professional information, search, education content, mobility', GLP1 to 'GLP-1 obesity drugs reduce demand for snacks, beverages, sleep-apnea/diabetes/cardio devices': none names a cable operator; the 10-K's own AI sentence ('A failure to effectively anticipate or adapt to new technologies (including those that use artificial intelligence (“AI”)) and changes in customer expectations and behavior could significantly adversely affect our competitive position with respect to the leisure time and discretionary spending of our customers and, as a result, affect our business and results of operations.') names a technology to adapt to, not a substitute for its connectivity services

theme_watch.reason: Live: Charter's own FY2024 10-K says 'However, services from virtual MVPDs and programmer streaming applications, as well as piracy and password sharing, negatively impact the number of customers purchasing our video product.' At the same time the same 10-K says it has generally viewed SVOD online video services as complementary to its own video offering, in the case of programmer streaming applications, it is packaging them with the linear offerings. The stock trades at 9.7x FY25E — a discount to its own history. The theme registry dates the market's pricing of streaming to 2015-08-04 (Disney lowers cable-network outlook on ESPN subscriber losses; media stocks sell off), evidence that names Disney's networks, not Charter. Re-file as DISRUPTION_EXPOSED (STREAMING) only if dated evidence shows the market pricing streaming substitution of Charter's video customers specifically.

BEAR.desc: EPS -2.4%/yr (worst year FY18-FY24, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +9.9%/yr (Q4 revenues + margin + buyback); P/E at its 7.3-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +37.3%/yr (FY18-FY24 CAGR, at least BASE); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +81.2%/yr (best 2-yr run FY18-FY24, at least BULL); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: CHTR (retrospective, 2025-04-04) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.00x (2.7% downside to Bear $329 / +808.1% upside to Bull $3072) | Adj composite 2.29 vs market 1.22: gap +1.07 [UNDERVALUED] | -43% above the EPP floor $594 (17x FY25E $34.97) | Conservative 2-yr case: +213.2% total (+106.6%/yr) | At 9.7x FY25E the 15% hurdle price $447 sits at or below the BASE case; customer relationships -2.0% in Q4 2024, forward revenues +1.57% (no FY25 revenue guide in numbers, Q4 2024 revenues as reported); streaming is live and company-acknowledged; no dated evidence ties the multiple to it.
